description: This file contains source code implementing ABI difference analysis and reporting, including functions to generate compatibility reports, compare translation units, extract user-defined types, and handle dynamic symbol exportables, primarily used for ABI compatibility checking in a software project.

classes.name: HeaderAbiDiff
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating ABI compatibility reports and comparing translation units, including functions for extracting user-defined types and collecting exportable symbols.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::GenerateCompatibilityReport
methods.description: Generates an ABI compatibility report by reading old and new ABI dumps, comparing the modules, and dumping differences.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CompareTUs
methods.description: Compares two translation units (modules) for ABI differences, collects types and symbols, and updates the diff report.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::ExtractUserDefinedTypes
methods.description: Extracts user-defined enum and record (struct/class) types from a translation unit.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectUserDefinedTypes
methods.description: Coordinates the collection of user-defined types from old and new translation units.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectUserDefinedTypesInternal
methods.description: Template method to collect user-defined types (enum or record) from old and new maps.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectDynsymExportables
methods.description: Collects added and removed exported dynamic symbols, including ELF symbols, and updates the diff report.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::Collect
methods.description: Internal function for collecting added and removed elements between old and new maps.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectElfSymbols
methods.description: Compares ELF symbol tables between old and new sets, and updates the diff report accordingly.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::PopulateElfElements
methods.description: Populates diff report with ELF symbols marked as added or removed.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::PopulateRemovedElements
methods.description: Adds removed elements to the diff report, with filtering options.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::PopulateCommonElements
methods.description: Handles common elements between old and new maps, diffing their differences.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::DumpLoneElements
methods.description: Outputs elements that are unique to either the old or new set, filtering out source files and weak symbols.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::DumpDiffElements
methods.description: Outputs differences between pairs of common elements.
